premise:
UNPUBLISHED, UNREVIEWED SOFTWARE-TEST DRAFT.
# SYNTHETIC C-valid: reconciliation and delivery-capacity schedule
Prepared 2026-09-28 solely as a fictional software-test scenario.
No real orders, facilities, persons, professional review or operating approval are asserted.

Lineage: derived from Synthetic local UX fixture C source v1,
SHA-256 f2d072fa17fd69a13399e0f4a3019a0eca55cfdbad53783cf48f862334f5a84e.
The original source and negative fixture remain unchanged.

For this derived scenario, one commitment requires one delivery slot
during the test delivery window 2026-09-29 through 2026-10-05.

RECONCILIATION: The signed register remains 300 commitments.
For this fictional derived scenario, the draft summary's figure of
600 was a duplicate-counting error. The corrected signed total is 300.
This correction does not alter what the original source recorded.

CAPACITY: This synthetic schedule allocates 300 delivery slots to
those 300 signed commitments for the stated test window. It allocates
no spare slots. Capacity beyond 300 is not evidenced by this schedule.

The historical forecast of 150 additional commitments and the later
analyst sensitivity of 120 are unverified assumptions. Neither is
included in signed demand or supported capacity.

LIMITATION: This document defines test facts. It is not an inspection,
a real capacity certificate, a completed professional review or
permission for real operations. A later signed total above 300
requires reassessment against new capacity evidence.

ADMINISTRATIVE DEADLINE: The synthetic review cutoff is
2026-10-05 18:00 Europe/Paris (2026-10-05T16:00:00.000Z).
This is a test-administration choice, not a legal deadline.

Transitions use fictional one-minute durations, zero monetary costs and zero score effects solely for this test. No automatic capacity arithmetic or actual governed simulation is claimed.
